description: This file contains an internal class implementing a hasher compatible with Orleans v3, specifically for string-only grain key IDs. It includes methods for hashing byte arrays and identifying grain type names based on byte content.

classes.name: Orleans3CompatibleStringKeyHasher
classes.description: Implements an Orleans v3-compatible hasher for string-only grain key IDs, providing customized hash computation and grain type identification.

methods.name: Orleans3CompatibleStringKeyHasher
methods.description: Constructor initializing the hasher with an inner hasher and grain type.

methods.name: Description
methods.description: Provides a description string of the hash function used.

methods.name: Hash
methods.description: Computes a hash for the given byte array, extending data if necessary, taking into account specific grain key considerations.

methods.name: IsGrainTypeName
methods.description: Determines if the provided byte array corresponds to the grain type name based on UTF-8 encoding and byte sequence comparison.
